space.origin: weapon-group origin, the same transform src/render/scene.ts applies to this.weapon
space.gripNote: gripSurface is the delivered support-palm contact point: gripSourceSurface + gripPalmOffset, identical to the GLB grip node. Use gripSurface for wiring; gripSourceSurface only records the rifle JSON surface it derives from.

nodes.rx24-root: animated root; children keep their own pivots
nodes.rifle-static: receiver, barrel, stock and sights; does not move during reload
nodes.rifle-magazine: pivot at the magazine; translate down 0.18 m and back during reload
nodes.rifle-bolt: charging handle; translate +Z 0.065 m at bolt-close
nodes.support-hand: support palm/fingers/wrist and sleeve; runtime gripOffset drives it
nodes.muzzle: empty anchor for flash and tracer origin
nodes.grip: empty anchor at the support palm contact surface (space.gripSurface); not the raw rifle surface

clips.name: idle
clips.source: original recipe; breathing sway, no ballistic effect

clips.name: fire
clips.source: src/render/weapon.ts weaponPose kick envelope, sampled at 20 ms

clips.name: reload-magazine
clips.source: WEAPONS.rifle.reload = 114 ticks at 60 Hz; withdraw 0.22-0.55, insert 0.55-0.77

clips.name: reload-bolt
clips.source: bolt-close phase 0.77-0.89 of the same reload clock

actions.name: idle
actions.notes: Feet and aim are owned by the player controller; the view model only breathes.

actions.name: move
actions.notes: src/render/weapon.ts sways at 9 rad/s by 4 mm and widens the crosshair; no baked move clip, because sway must track current speed.

actions.name: fire
actions.notes: Root kick is presentation only. Ray direction and recoil remain src/sim values and are not changed by this clip.

actions.name: reload
actions.notes: The whole-gun lowering and the support-hand path stay procedural in src/render/weapon.ts and src/render/arm.ts. The GLB supplies the magazine and bolt nodes so a future segmented view model can play the same phases; do not replace the reload with a single rifle tilt.

actions.name: hit
actions.notes: First-person arms do not receive the enemy hit reaction; the hit-feedback piece owns hit confirmation.

actions.name: death
actions.notes: The player view is hidden on death by src/render/scene.ts; no death clip is exported.

gaps: No skinned hand rig: the support hand and sleeve remain a rest-pose recipe, so runtime keeps rebuilding the sleeve from two arm segments.
The GLB is not loaded by src. Wiring needs a GLTFLoader path plus per-node pose application that preserves the existing simulation clock.
Finger contact and screen coverage in idle, fire and reload must be judged in the real game view; geometry checks are only regression gates.
